parsed.evidence: In the bright, unmodified support pixels of both the close and wide spotlight views, there is a distinct dark, linear feature running through the landscape. In the wide view, this feature clearly exhibits the morphology of a canal or river, complete with straight banks and a bridge crossing it. The color is a deep, uniform dark grey/black typical of water bodies in satellite imagery, contrasting with the surrounding vegetation and built-up areas. This confirms the class as water.
